questions.q: Religious mania with a desire to cut and tear things, and cold sweat on the forehead, points to:
questions.why: Veratrum album: religious mania, destructive impulses to cut and tear, with cold sweat on the forehead (Boericke).

questions.q: Tissue bridges, ragged margins and bruised edges in a wound indicate a:
questions.why: A laceration is a tear from blunt force, leaving nerves and vessels as tissue bridges; incised wounds have clean edges.

questions.q: The abbreviation 'q.s.' on a prescription means:
questions.why: Q.s. is quantum sufficit, as much as is needed; 'as much as desired' is ad lib.

questions.q: Volkmann's ischaemic contracture is a classic complication of:
opts: supracondylar fracture of the humerus in children
fracture of the shaft of the femur
questions.why: Brachial artery injury or compression in supracondylar fracture causes forearm muscle ischaemia and contracture.

questions.q: In Kent's sixth observation, too short a relief of symptoms after a remedy points to:
opts: organic (structural) changes or something interfering with the remedy
a remedy that was too deep for the case
questions.why: Kent: amelioration that lasts too short a time suggests structural change in the organs, or in acute cases a rapidly advancing process.

questions.q: In active management of the third stage of labour, the uterotonic of choice is:
opts: ergometrine 0.5 mg IV before delivery of the shoulder
misoprostol 1000 mcg rectally after the placenta
oxytocin 10 IU IM within one minute of birth
questions.why: WHO and Indian guidelines recommend oxytocin 10 IU IM as the first-choice uterotonic for AMTSL.

questions.q: In evaluating a case for the choice of the remedy, §153 gives most importance to symptoms that are:
opts: common to the disease, like fever and weakness
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. §153: the characteristic symptoms individualise the remedy.

questions.q: A pregnant woman should receive tetanus–diphtheria (Td) vaccine as:
opts: two doses (or one booster if vaccinated within the last 3 years)
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Under the UIP.

questions.q: A potency labelled '200K' has been prepared by:
questions.why: The suffix K marks potencies made by Korsakov's single-vial method.

questions.q: Before the HPI was published, Indian manufacturers mainly followed:
opts: the American (HPUS) and German homoeopathic pharmacopoeias
the Indian Pharmacopoeia of allopathic drugs
questions.why: Until the HPI appeared, Indian firms worked to the Homoeopathic Pharmacopoeia of the United States and the German pharmacopoeia.
